name: Calf raise hold
instructions: Stand tall and rise up onto the balls of your feet.
Hold at the top, keeping your legs straight.
Lower back down with control when you are done.
cue: Rise up, hold at the top
mistakes: Letting the heels drift down during the hold.
Losing balance and holding a wall too hard.
